prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1386; do not mention it.)
text: I was driving east through the intersection on a green light when a pickup truck coming from the cross street did not stop and struck the driver's side of my vehicle. I felt a hard jolt and my car spun slightly before coming to rest against the curb. I was able to get out on my own, and I stayed at the scene until the officer arrived and took statements from both drivers. Afterward I noticed stiffness and pain in my neck that worsened over the next day, and I was diagnosed with a neck strain. I have been following the treatment plan my doctor recommended, including physical therapy and limited rest from lifting. I am providing this account so the claim can be processed accurately, and I am willing to supply the police report and any medical records needed to support it.
